tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang skor gyi dbang gi lag len gsal ba'i

sgron me bzhugs so/ / ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdod ma'i mgon po yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub kun tu bzang po dang*/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal te/ /gsang skor snyan brgyud dbang gi lag len bri/ /de la gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal dris byugs par tshangs zur gyis thig gdab la rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i nang ma la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ bar ma la bcu drug /phyi ma la nyi shu rtsa bzhi bris la/ lte ba mthing ka'i shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu/ mtshams dang gzhan rnams mdzes tshon du bskyed la/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar dpal gtor spod dang chang gis brdzis pa'i mtha' bskor du/ chos skyong spyi/ sngags srung*/ gza'/ dam can/ gzhi bdag lnga'i gtor ma dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang bcas pa bshams te/ slob dpon rang nyid skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ ā+oṃ yo ga shud+dho sarba dharmā swa bhā wa ād+ma ko ྅haṃ gis stong pa'i ngang las/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad srung ba'i 'khor lo/ ye shes kyi me ri me dpung dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bh+ruṃ las 'ja' tshon spel ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nangadu seng ge nyi zla rin po che'i khri la/ dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum sku mdog mthing ga mnyam par sbyor ba/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gsal btab la/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa brjod nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa de skad cig gis bh+ruṃ las 'od lnga'i gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bskyed pa'i dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba'i mthar/ rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa dang*/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ de'i phyir rim du rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin du gsal btab la/ rnga dang rol mo'i sgra sgrog cing 'di skad do/

/hūm̐ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas ye shes rol ba'i lha/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rig 'dzin bla mar bcas/ /chos kyi dbyings las sgyu mar skur bzhengs shig /hūm̐ ma g.yel ma g.yel rig 'dzin tshogs/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel yi dam lha/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel srung ma'i tshogs/ /rgyal po'i pho brang gang na yod pa na/ /yul khams skye bo thams cad de na 'du/ /bstan pa'i snying po gang na yod pa na/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyang de na 'du/ /nyi ma'i snying po gang na shar ba na/ /'od zer mang po 'phro zhing 'du ba ltar/ /byang chub sems kyi dgongs klong gsal ba na/ /zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs kyang de na 'du/ /nam mkha' stong la lho sprin gtibs pa bzhin/ /rig 'dzin dam can tshogs kyang de na 'du/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu bran 'du ba bzhin/ /ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyang de na 'du/ / lhun gyis grub pa'i rigs 'dzin ma g.yel zhig /phyag rgya chen po tshe la dbang ba yi/ /rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin ma g.yel zhig /hūm̐ nyi ma lta bu'i pho brang nas/ /chos sku kun bzang yab yum la/ /'khor du ye shes rgya mtshos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /'ja' tshon 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /longs sku rigs lnga yab yum la/ /'khor du byang chub sems dpas bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /'khor du nye ba'i sras kyis bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas/ /ston pa dga' rab rdo rje la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /bsil pa tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ /gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/

/byang chub 'byung ba'i shing drung nas/ gu ru shrī sidha la/ / 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /bha sing chen po'i dur khrod nas/ /gu ru bi ma mi tra la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i dge gong nas/ /nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo ru gzong phug pho brang nas/ /rje btsun blo gros dbang phyug la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po sa bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /brag dkar rta so'i pho brang nas/ /gu ru rin chen 'bar ba la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /klungs shod zhwa yi lha khang nas/ /gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / 'od le zam kha'i pho brang nas/ /lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / g.yo ru brag dmar pho brang nas/ /gu ru shong pa ras pa la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yu phug gsal ba'i pho brang nas/ /bla ma zab stong chos 'bar la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / nyang smad chu sgo'i dgon pa nas/ /dam pa dgyer ston zhig po la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / nyang smad chu sgo'i sman sgang nas/ /gnyan ston shes rab rtse mo la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / yon tan sgang gi gnas mchog nas/ /drin chen sprul sku mched gnyis la/ / 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/

/'od gsal dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje la/ / 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /rang byung ye shes pho brang nas/ /rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub rig pa'i pho brang nas/ /kun mkhyen sna tshogs rang grol la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes spyan drangs pas steng gi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du byon te bdag dang*/ rten gtor bskyed pa dang*/ gnas rnams la dbyer med du byin rlob cing sa gzhi bar snang dang bcas pa thams cad bla ma'i zhing khams su bsams la/ byin dbab pa ni/ rig 'dzin dben gnas so so nas/ /bla ma bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*/ /'khor du brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thib/ /rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo/ /rol mo mang po di ri ri/ /sil snyan mang po sil li li/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /hūm̐ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /yi dam rgyal ba rigs lnga la/ /'khor du sems dpa' bcu drug bskor/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thib/ /rin chen rgyan kha khro lo lo/ /rol mo mang po di ri ri/ /sil snyan mang po sil li li/ / gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /hūm̐ rang byung dur khrod so so nas/ /ma dang ye shes mkha' 'gro la/ / 'khor du dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thib/ /rin chen rgya cha khro lo lo/ /rol mo mang po di ri ri/ /sil snyan mang po sil li li/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /bstan pa'i snying po'i bka' 'khor nas/ /sngags bdag ye shes stobs ldan la/ /'khor du dam can rgya mtshos bskor/

/gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thib/ /rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo/ /rol mo mang po di ri ri/ /sil snyan mang po sil li li/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang rten dang gnas kyi nam mkha' gang bar dbyer med gcig tu bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ phy-i yi mchod pa rin po che/ /snang srid rnam dag mchod par 'bul/ /skye 'gag med par bzhes su gsol/ /nang gi mchod pa rin po che/ /'dod yon sna lnga mchod par 'bul/ /rgyun chad med par bzhes su gsol/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rin po che/ /dug lnga khong khro mchod par 'bul/ /'gro 'ong med par bzhes su gsol/ /yang gsang mchod pa rin po che/ /ting 'dzin dgongs klong mchod par 'bul/ /'phel 'gribs med par bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod nas/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ gdod nas rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa las/ /rang byung ye shes bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha/ / kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /rig 'dzin bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skye med ngang las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs pa/ /rdo rje phag mo rigs bzhi mkha' 'gror bcas/ /mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro thogs med rdzu 'phrul can/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i tshogs la bstod/ / che ba'i rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /mthu stobs dpag med sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*/ /sgrub mchog rnams la bu bzhin legs skyong ba/ / dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sta gon gyi cho ga rnams rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba dngos la gnyis las/ sngon 'gro ni na rag rgyas bsdus gang rung gi skong bshags dang*/ mos gus khyad par can gyis gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes la slob bus maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa la/ bla mas dam pa'i chos ngos gzung ba ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/

/spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba des/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don du chos kyi sgo dang*/ tha ེ ga pa'i rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'dir theg pa chen po ston pa lags/ theg pa chen po la yang gsang sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis las/ da res 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ston pa lags/ sngags la'ang phyi nang gnyis las/ 'dir nang pa thabs kyi rgyud ston pa lags/ nang pa la yang bskyed pa ma hā yo ga dang*/ lung a nu yo ga dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga gsum las/ 'dir a ti ston pa lags/ a ti la yang phyi skor/ nang skor/ gsang skor gsum las/ 'dir gsang ba'i skor ston pa lags/ de la yang dpe brgyud dang snyan brgyud gnyis las/ 'dir snyan brgyud ston pa lags/ snyan brgyud la yang yi ge can dang yi ge med pa gnyis las/ 'dir yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud gsang ba gnad kyi me long zhes bgyi ba ston pa lags/ de la 'ang ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir dbang ston pa lags/ de la yang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i dbang gnyis las/ lo rgyus rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa zhig bshad la/ gnyis pa dbang dngos la/ sngon 'gro slob ma gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos gnyis las/ slob ma 'jug pa la lnga las/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed thun mong ma yin pa ni/ slob mas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /bla med byang chub sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa gsum dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa sdom pa gzung ba ni/

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /sdom pa thams cad gzung bar bgyi/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig rjes bzung ste/ /rdo rje'i dril bu la sogs pa/ /dam tshig rdzas rnams gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje slob dpon nyid dang ni/ /dkon mchog gsum po mi spang zhing*/ /rdo rje spun sring smad mi bgyi/ /theg pa dman la mi brnyas shing*/ /sems can kun la 'tshe ba spang*/ /chos dang gang zag mi smod cing/ /'khrul pa'i bya ba yang mi bgyid/ /bstan pa smad par mi bya zhing*/ / bsam gtan sgom pa dkrugs mi bya/ /gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig mchog /sku gsung thugs las mi 'da' zhing*/ /bskyed rdzogs 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ /bla mas gsungs pa ji bzhin bsgrub/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol pa rnams dgrol ba dang*/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa dam tshig la gnas par bya ba la gnyis las/ dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ thod pa nas dam chu blud la/ hūṃ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig chu/ /'das na dmyal khams me yi bsreg / bsrungs na dngos grub bla na med/ /de bas dam tshig rdo rje mchog /snying la bzhag pas thub par gyis/ /ā+oṃ sa ma yā pañca a mṛ ta hrī thāḥ zhes brjod do/ / dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ bla mas/ kyai skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig nyon/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'dir zhugs nas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa dang*/ /dam chos bsgrubs par dam chos shig /ji ltar sngags kyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa thams cad gzung bar bgyi/ /dam rdzas rnams dang sngags kyi tshig /dbang bskur ma thob mi rnams la/ /gsang ba bsgrags par mi bya zhing*/

/bsten pa kun la gnod pa spang*/ /gang gis rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dngos grub mchog la reg par bgyi/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rjes su gzung ba la gnyis las/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig po/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs/ /thar pa'i lam skas chen po ste/ /ma rig sel pa'i sgron me la/ /mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /nyon mongs me yis gdungs pa la/ /thugs rje'i brlan gyis bsil bar mdzod/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzang po 'dir/ /bdag ni yang dag gzhug par gsol/ / zhes pa gsum dang*/ yang 'di skad do/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /bdag ni gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /dbang bskur nang du zhugs lags pas/ /rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs kyi/ /a ti'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /zhes gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bla mas/ e ma bu khyod skal ba bzang*/ /rdzogs chen dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /sems kyi rtog pa kun sol la/ /'jig rten 'ching ba kun grol gyis/ /'di la spang blang tha snyad bral/ /rigs dang rgyud rnams sbyong ba yis/ /lus ngag bde ba'i rten yin pas/ /deng nas brtsams te slar ma ldog

/ces brjod do/ /lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/ slob ma kun langs la/ thal mo snying gar sbyar mig btsum/ dad gus bskyed la/ bla ma'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam rigs lnga dang*/ mkha' 'gro rigs lnga'i sprin phung gtibs te/ rim pas gsal btab la dbyer med du bstim zhing*/ so so'i mtshan dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing*/ spos dang tshil chen gyi dud pas bdug go /des ni ye shes phebs so/ /don gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ slob ma skyil krung bcas la rdo rje sems dpar sgom du bcug pa'i spyi bor gtor ma bzhag la/ sngar gsal btab pa'i bla ma/ yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum po'i rnam pa dang*/ slob dpon rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba rnams kyi dbu'i gtsug tor nas 'od zer dkar po grangs med pa byung*/ slob bu'i lus la phog pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis lus khengs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ rtags su rnam par snang mdzad tshon gang bas dbu brgyan par bsams la/ hūṃ sku yi dbang bskur lus la bskur/ /lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas/ /sku yi dngos grub thob gyur te/ / bum dbang rin chen rdzogs par shog /ā+oṃ kā ya ka la sha a bha ི ṣīñca ā+oṃ/ gtor ma mgrin par gtugs te lha dang bla ma'i mgul nas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ slob bu'i ngag la phog /ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsams la/ hūṃ gsung gi dbang bskur ngag la bskur/ /ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// gsung gi dngos grub thob gyur te/ /gsang dbang rin chen rdzogs par shog /āḥwā ka ghu ya a bhi ṣīñca āḥ / gtor ma snying gar gtugs la/ lha dang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing ga byung*/ slob ma'i snying gar phog / yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

lus khengs/ bde ba chen por ro gcig tu bsam te/ hūṃ thugs kyi dbang bskur sems la bskur/ /yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas/ /thugs kyi dngos grub thob gyur te/ /shes rab ye shes dbang rdzogs shog /hūṃ tsit+ta pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣīñca hūṃ/ /zhes brjod nas/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che rdzogs chen rig pa'i rtsal dbang ni/ sems nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang du glod nas rig pa'i rang gdangs zang thal chos kyi sku de rang rdzogs thig le nyag gcig tu ngo sprad do/ /dbang rin po che'i 'khor lo las/ sngon rgya gar gyi yul grong khyer ser skya zhes bya bar/ rgyal po'i phrug gu ltad mo la phyin pas/ rgyal bu rkang 'khyams te/ sprang po lta bur song*/ de nas dus nam zhig na/ blon pos ngo shes nas/ dbang bskur bas 'khor 'bangs mnga' 'og tu 'dus so/ /de bzhin du thog ma'i sangs rgyas dang*/ sems can 'od mthong ba las/ rang ngo ma shes 'khrul bar shar/ / de la ngo sprod bstan pa ni/ / rang rig ye shes dbang bskur bas/ / 'khor ba'i mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /zhes pas stai/ dpe rgyal bu/ don rang rig /rtags da lta'i shes pa rang mdangs rang shar ba 'di sangs rgyas su nges shes bskyed la ngo sprad do/ /de nas tshogs la rol zhing gtor ma dngos grub tu shes pas longs spyod la/ bsngo ba smon lam rdo rje'i glu/ lhag ma'i gtor ma/ bkra shis dang bcas pa'i grangs yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /yi ge snga mar cung zad ma tshang ba rnams dang*/ cung zad gab pa rnams bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar lhag chad med par bkod pa'o/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam zhugs te/ / 'gas kyang ma 'bad sus kyang ma rtsol bar/ / don gnyis lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por shog /snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i sgo 'byed/ dbang rin po che gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/

sna tshogs rang grol gyis bkod pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (12)gsang skor gyi dbang gi lag len gsal ba'i sgron me/ -PAGE 4--PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
